description.narrative:
The main objective of the project Migrants as Agents for Change is to strengthen the social fabric of the migrant population through its institutional strengthening and the advocacy capacity of its grassroots organizations in the northern triangle of Central America. The purpose is that, through their strengthening, they themselves can strengthen their bases, participate in spaces of national and regional strategic incidence, as well as make public policy proposals for the defense of their rights, among them, the right to work.
The overall objective is divided into two general objectives: 1) To strengthen the capacity of migrant led organisations to influence policy, legislation and practice at the local and national level and strengthen human rights for migrants. 2) To design multi-sector mechanisms and establish three-party cooperation to support the socio-economic integration of migrants at local level.

Projektet ”Migranter som förändringsagenter-Stärkande av kapacitet för påverkansarbete och ledarskap hos migrantbaserade organisationer i norra triangeln i Centralameriaka (Guatemala, Honduras och El Salvador) genomförs av Fundación Avina under perioden november 2022 – januari 2024. Huvudsyftet med projektet är att stärka organisationsstrukturer hos migranter och återvändare för ökad kapacitet att delta i nationella och regionala processer, utforma och driva förslag till policys som garanterar migranters rättigheter, bland annat rätten att arbeta. Det övergripande målet är uppdelat i två delmål: 1) Att stärka kapaciteten hos migrantledda organisationer att påverka politik, lagstiftning och praxis på lokal och nationell nivå för att stärka migranters mänskliga rättigheter. 2) Att utforma multisektoriella mekanismer och etablera trepartssamarbete, som sammanför lokala myndigheter, den privata sektorn och det civila samhället, för att stödja socioekonomisk integration av migranter på lokal nivå. Fundación Avina är en latinamerikansk organisation med 25 års erfarenhet av att arbeta med migration, stöd till civilsamhället och ekonomiskt stärkande av migranter i Latinamerika. Fundación Avina kommer att samarbeta med 15 lokala organisationer som arbetar med och för migrationer samt med det regionala nätverket av civilsamhällesorganisationer som arbetar med migrationsfrågor.

The project Migrants as agents for change: Strengthening the advocacy and leadership capacity of migrant based organizations in the Northern Triangle in Central America is implemented by Fundación Avina during the period November 2022 – January 2024. The main objective of the project is to strengthen the social fabric of the migrant population through its institutional strengthening and the advocacy capacity of its grassroots organizations in the northern triangle of Central America. The purpose is that, through their strengthening, they themselves can strengthen their bases, participate in spaces of national and regional strategic incidence, as well as make public policy proposals for the defense of their rights, among them, the right to work. The overall objective is divided into two general objectives: 1) To strengthen the capacity of migrant led organizations to influence policy, legislation and practice at the local and national level and strengthen human rights for migrants. 2) To design multi-sector mechanisms and establish three-party cooperation, bringing together local authorities, private sector and civil society, to support the socio-economic integration of migrants at local level. Fundación Avina is a Latin American organization with 25 years of experience of working with migration, support to civil society and economic empowerment of migrants in Latin America. Fundación Avina will collaborate with 15 local organizations working with and for migrations and with the regional network of civil society organizations working on migration issues.
